title: From Questions to Queries to Insights: A Schema-Grounded Agentic Workflow for Natural-Language Crash Data Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2610.35054v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Transportation agencies maintain extensive crash databases to identify safety priorities, evaluate countermeasures, and guide resource allocation. Making these data accessible to practitioners requires flexible ways to translate analytical questions into reliable results. Existing dashboards support predefined analyses, while additional requests often depend on specialists who understand database queries, coded fields, and agency conventions. This study presents CrashDB-QA, a fully local, schema-grounded agentic workflow that enables natural-language analysis of crash databases. Specialized components interpret questions, generate and validate read-only SQL, execute queries, and explain the results. A shared knowledge base grounds query construction in the agency's data dictionary and safety-analysis conventions, while recorded intermediate outputs support inspection and auditing. An optional extension, CrashDB-QA+, checks the alignment

translated_title: 从问题到查询再到洞察：一种基于数据库模式的自然语言交通事故数据分析智能体工作流
translated_abstract: 交通运输机构维护着庞大的交通事故数据库，用于识别安全优先事项、评估对策措施并指导资源配置。要让从业者能够便捷使用这些数据，需要灵活的方式将分析问题转化为可靠的结果。现有的仪表板仅支持预定义的分析，而额外的分析请求往往依赖于精通数据库查询、编码字段和机构惯例的专业人员。本研究提出了 CrashDB-QA，这是一个完全本地化部署、基于数据库模式的智能体工作流，可实现对交通事故数据库的自然语言分析。专门的组件负责解析问题、生成并验证只读 SQL、执行查询并解释结果。共享知识库将查询构建锚定在机构的数据字典和安全分析惯例之上，同时记录的中间输出支持结果核查与审计。研究还提出了一个可选的扩展版本 CrashDB-QA+，用于检查对齐性……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出 CrashDB-QA，一个完全本地化、以数据模式和安全分析惯例为基准的智能体工作流，使交通从业者能够通过自然语言对交通事故数据库进行可靠、可审计的自动查询与分析。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces CrashDB-QA, a fully local, schema-grounded agentic workflow that enables transportation practitioners to reliably analyze crash databases through natural language, with SQL generation anchored in the agency's data dictionary and safety-analysis conventions for inspection and auditing.
